full_prompt_en: The square image is a mixed-media painting of an abstracted male profile in muted charcoal, pale grey and rust orange, facing toward the right against a deep blue-black ground. The head fills most of the frame, with the nose and lips extending toward the right edge and a dark high collar and shoulder mass occupying the lower-left. The face is pale and nearly unmodelled, with a straight nose bridge, closed mouth and a distinct chin emerging from the surrounding darkness. The eye area is obscured by a dense black patch, leaving the profile expressionless and mask-like. Around the ear and temple on the left side, long sharp fragments radiate outward in a fan of grey, cream and orange strokes. Their tapered forms cross one another and converge near a small bright point at the temple, where fine lines and flecks gather. A broad burnt-orange strip cuts through the upper-left region, accompanied by narrow cream and slate marks that angle toward the same centre. The rest of the background stays dark and relatively empty, though faint scratched lines and soft cloudy patches are visible near the lower edge. The contrast between the smooth, pale face and the jagged radiating shapes gives the image a split, interrupted surface. The face remains recognisable despite the hidden eye and missing fine details; the hairline dissolves into fragments, and a dark high collar is visible below the jaw. Light is concentrated on the forehead, nose and cheek, while the eye socket, lower jaw and background recede into charcoal shadow. The orange marks add the only strong warmth to an otherwise cool monochrome palette. The strongest fragments are concentrated at the left side of the head, where several long forms cross at different angles and break into finer lines near their tips. A few narrow strokes continue outward into the dark field, while others stop abruptly at the forehead. The ear itself is mostly absorbed into this cluster, so the point of origin is suggested by the surrounding geometry rather than fully outlined. The pale profile remains smooth around the nose and mouth, making the scattered marks feel sharply separate from the face. There is no visible lettering, accessory or distinct setting. The radiating lines are longest above the ear and shorten as they approach the brow. The nose forms the clearest projecting edge within the otherwise softened profile. The overall composition directs attention from the calm right-facing profile to the explosive fragments around the temple, balancing stillness and visual rupture in a dark, graphic frame.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的抽象化男性侧脸混合媒介绘画，面部以炭灰、浅灰与锈橙色表现，朝向画面右侧，背景为深蓝黑色。头部占据画面大部分，鼻子和嘴唇朝右缘伸展，下方左侧则被深色高领与肩部块面覆盖。面部浅淡且塑形简略，直鼻梁、闭合嘴唇和清楚下巴从周围暗部中显出。眼部被浓重黑块遮住，使侧脸显得无表情，近似面具。头部左侧的耳朵与太阳穴周围，长而尖锐的碎片以扇状向外放射，色彩包括灰、奶油白和橙色。它们彼此交叉，尖端在太阳穴附近一处亮点汇聚，细线和斑点也聚集于此。宽阔的焦橙色条带切过左上方，旁边狭窄的奶油白与石板灰笔痕以斜角指向相同中心。其余背景保持深暗且相对空旷，不过靠近下缘仍可见淡淡刮擦线和云状色痕。平滑浅色面孔与太阳穴周围锯齿状放射形体相对，使画面表面呈现分裂与中断感。尽管眼睛被隐藏、细节省略，侧脸仍清楚可辨；发际融入碎片，下颌下方仍能看到深色高领。光线集中在额头、鼻子与面颊，眼窝、下颌下方和背景退入炭灰阴影。橙色痕迹为原本偏冷的单色配色带来唯一强烈暖意。最强烈的碎片集中在头部左侧，数道长形体以不同角度交叉，并在末端分解为更细线条。几道窄笔痕继续向外伸入暗色区域，另一些则在额头附近戛然而止。耳朵本身大多融入这一组形体，因此放射起点由周围几何关系暗示，并未完整勾勒。浅色侧脸在鼻子和嘴唇周围仍然平滑，使散落笔痕与面部之间产生清晰断差。画面看不到文字、配饰或明确场景。放射线在耳朵上方最长，越靠近眉弓越短。鼻梁是柔化侧脸中最清晰的突出边缘。整体构图从平静的右向侧脸引向太阳穴周围爆发般的碎片，在深色图形画幅中平衡静止感与视觉断裂。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media image combines smooth tonal planes with sharp linear fragments and scraped marks. Charcoal, pale grey and cream form a restrained base, while rust orange concentrates attention in a few directional strokes. Hard edges radiate from a focal point and interrupt broader soft transitions. Fine scratches, flecks and cloudy underlayers keep the surface visibly worked. Light is selective, isolating pale areas against deep shadow and leaving large dark regions quiet. The overall visual language is fragmented and graphic, balancing controlled negative space with an abrupt burst of line and colour.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介画面将平滑调性色面与锐利线性碎片、刮擦痕迹结合。炭黑、浅灰和奶油白构成克制底色，锈橙色则集中在少数具有方向性的笔痕上。硬朗边缘从一个焦点放射，打断较宽阔的柔和过渡。细刮痕、斑点和云状底层让表面保留明显手工痕迹。光线具有选择性，使浅色区域从深影中分离，并让大块暗部保持安静。整体视觉语言断裂而图形化，在受控留白与突发的线色之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Right-facing pale male profile with grey and orange fragments radiating from the temple
theme_zh: 太阳穴放射灰橙碎片的浅色右向男性侧脸
name: Eric Lacombe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
